claims.claim: The narrative of cultural criticism concerning the relation of natural and artificial turns into a narrative of political philosophy when examining Arendt's work.
claims.supporting_excerpt:
Following the argumentation of The Human Condition concerning the relation of nat-
ural and artificial we arrived to a turning point where the narrative of cultural criti -
cism converts into the narrative of political philosophy.

claims.claim: Totalitarianism represents the end-result of processes of re-naturalization, aiming to change the human race into an animal species and kill human individuality.
qualifications: required an arsenal of new technologies including modern telecommunication, psycho-technologies, and organizational-institutional technologies
claims.supporting_excerpt:
It is important concerning the subject of this paper that totalitarianism was the
end-result of the processes of re-naturalization. For the introduction of this unprec -
edented political form an arsenal of new technologies was needed.

must_not_be_lost: The connection between The Origins of Totalitarianism and The Human Condition regarding the process of re-naturalization and the threat to the man-made world.
segment_function: Discussing the transition from cultural criticism to political philosophy by examining Arendt's previous work The Origins of Totalitarianism, focusing on the concepts of process, imperialism, and re-naturalization.
